mods.name: ApocaHUD43
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Keeps the HUD on the screen edges at any aspect ratio (4:3, 16:10, 21:9).

latest.title: ApocaHUD43 1.0.2
latest.notes:
Keeps Apocalypter's HUD on the screen edges at any aspect ratio (4:3, 16:10, 21:9).

The game lays its HUD out for 16:9 with everything anchored to the screen centre, so on 4:3 the bottom row (weapon card, survival card, quick items, ammo / nuts / armour, compass) hangs above the bottom of the screen. ApocaHUD43 re-anchors each element to the edge or corner it was designed next to:

- bottom / top rows stick to the bottom / top edge, corner groups to their corners
- survival rows (health, hunger, thirst, fatigue, sanity, radiation) stay in the bottom-left corner
- the loading screen picture covers the whole screen (aspect kept, edges cropped)
- the middle of the screen (crosshair, item names, prompts, scopes) is unchanged; at 16:9 nothing moves
- works with Apocapocket's extra slot card 4 / 5 / 6

**Install:** BepInEx 5.4.x; copy `ApocaHUD43.dll` from the zip into `Apocalypter\BepInEx\plugins\`.
Config: `[General] Enabled` (live toggle, also in the Apocasetter Mods menu).

mods.name: Apocaplayer

mods.summary: See your character: a full body in first person, a third-person camera on foot and in cars, and a choice of a female character or the game's own man.

latest.title: Apocaplayer 1.6.3
latest.notes:
**First person**

- New setting 1st person arms visible (General, default off): hides the body's arms in first person so they don't block the view when crouching or driving.
- First-person (on foot / driving) camera X/Y/Z offsets in [Debug]; driving view re-centred on the head by default.
- The neck/shoulder cut in first person is now a solid black surface instead of a see-through hole; the body no longer turns see-through where the camera clips it.
- Max now has his own first-person hands.

**Culling**

- 3rd-person camera culling never cuts away the ground.

- The equipped flashlight is worn on the body: Police flashlight on the left belt pointing forward, Old/Military flashlight on the left chest (80 % size). It glows when switched on.

- TAB inventory picture switches correctly after changing character.
- Max's first-person gloves re-textured: clean dark leather that follows the fist's folds and seams instead of smeared patches and specks.
- Updated Female model.

latest.title: Apocapocket 2.0.5
latest.notes:
## Apocapocket 2.0.5

**Fix: every pocketed item comes back into its slot after loading** - including items the game builds without its usual item scripts, such as the empty alcohol canister, which used to stay on the ground ("Load: missing pocket item ..." in the log).

latest.title: Apocaraider 1.7.0
latest.notes:
## Changes since 1.5.5

- **Shoota - female Sprokka:** a share of the Sprokkas the game spawns are now Shootas, with their own body, no armour vest, the female voice, and their own corpse. They stay Shootas after save and load.

mods.name: Apocasaver
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Autosave into the slot you are playing and give your saves names.

latest.title: Apocasaver 1.9.1
latest.notes:
# 1.9.1

- Add optional Apocapocket inventory compatibility. Wait for inventory operations and pocket load restoration before saving.
- Verify physical hand parenting before treating GrabItem's cached `Item` reference as held.
- Protect pocket-owned objects in every slot, including the last item stored and objects temporarily moved into the world
  by Apocapocket's save normalization. Release stale native grab references without executing drop actions on stored items.
- Wait for pocket normalization to finish before completing autosave; queued re-equip operations do not block resuming.
- Preserve Apocapocket's own vehicle-part restart flags when an item transfers from the hand into its custody.

Validation: clean Release build; 76 simulated transaction/compatibility checks; native hook targets and installed
Apocapocket inventory bindings verified. Interactive confirmation of the reported last-stored-item case is pending.

Install: replace `BepInEx\plugins\Apocasaver.dll` with the DLL in `Apocasaver-1.9.1.zip`, then restart the game. No Apocapocket
replacement is required; compatibility bindings were checked against Apocapocket 2.0.4.

mods.name: Apocasetter
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: In-game Mods menu: settings for every mod, updates, install and remove from GitHub, without leaving the game.

latest.title: Apocasetter 2.0.9
latest.notes:
## Apocasetter 2.0.9

**Mods that need other mods.** When a mod's index entry says it requires another mod:
- **Updating** to a version that newly needs one installs that mod at the same restart; the update banner tells you so.
- **Disabling or removing** a mod also disables the mods that can't run without it (the dialog names them). Their files and settings stay; ENABLE brings both back.
- **Enabling** a disabled mod brings its requirements back too.
- A mod whose requirement is missing anyway shows a red **NEEDS …** block with an INSTALL or ENABLE button.

**Install / update**
- From the Mods window: CHECK FOR UPDATES → Apocasetter → UPDATE → QUIT GAME TO APPLY.
- By hand: unzip into the game folder (the zip holds `BepInEx/plugins/Apocasetter/` and `BepInEx/patchers/Apocasetter.Installer.dll`). Requires BepInEx 5.x.

mods.name: Apocatremors
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Mutants burst out of the sand ahead of your car while you drive, more often the farther you go.

latest.title: Apocatremors 1.2.0
latest.notes:
Config cleanup + ambush clock change.

- The config now has only `[General]` (Enabled, ShowNotification, CooldownMinSeconds, CooldownMaxSeconds, SkipChance, DistanceMultiplier, DespawnDistance, MaxAlive), `[Apocapatrol]` (Enabled — the former AiCars, PlayerCooldownMultiplier, PlayerSkipChance) and `[Debug]` (TestKey, VerboseLog). Everything else is fixed in code at its former default; the per-creature sections are gone (their rules live in the code). Old keys and sections are removed from your cfg automatically.

Install: copy `Apocatremors.dll` into `BepInEx\plugins\` (BepInEx 5). DLL md5 `903451415cac4c6d8c691d13104a3d5a`.

mods.name: Apocaunloader
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Hold R to unload your gun; the rounds go back into your backpack.

latest.title: Apocaunloader v1.2.0
latest.notes:
Fixes ammo loss caused by the vanilla capacity clamp when switching to a smaller backpack.

- Excess ammunition drops as matching ammo boxes instead of disappearing.
- Removing a backpack restores normal ammo capacities and drops the excess. The brief empty slot during a swap does not trigger removal drops.
- Batteries drop as a pack with the exact excess count; grenades drop individually.
- If a drop cannot be created and registered for saving, ammo is retained and the mod retries once per second.
- New `DropBackpackOverflow` setting is enabled by default.

**Install:** extract `Apocaunloader_1.2.0.zip` into the game folder, replacing `BepInEx/plugins/Apocaunloader.dll`.

**Validation:** Release build passes without warnings. Conservation and retry tests pass, including 15,251 count/capacity combinations. In-game pickup and save/reload behavior has not yet been verified.

mods.name: NPCAI
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: NPCs that see, hear, search and pursue, find their way through camps and buildings, and aim within their weapon's reach. Part of what was Apocaraider.

latest.title: NPCAI 1.1.2
latest.notes:
## NPCAI 1.1.2

Gunmen reload.

- Magazine per gun = the player's own weapon capacity, read from the game's Reload FSMs (AKs / M16 30, akm_drum 70, borz 25, folk_17 17, revolver 5, Slambergs 5, Redmarks 4, Rochesters 2, pipe pistol / slam-fire / crossbow 1; the 22_pipe_smg's 165 cut to 30). Hidden `[NpcAim] MagazineTable`.
- Every ray of a burst is a shot; a burst never fires past the magazine (a single-shot gun fires one ray per burst); the next burst is replaced by the reload.
- With Apocaplayer: `RifleReload` / `PistolReload` on an upper-body layer over the legs - he keeps strafing, backing up or kneeling while reloading, like the player. `ReloadSeconds` without the clip, `SingleShotReload` (1 s) for 1-2 round guns.
- Reload sounds: the clips the player's copy of that gun plays while reloading, 3D at the NPC (`ReloadVolume`, `ReloadSoundRange`).
- A running chaser with an empty gun reloads when he next squares up. `Magazines = false` turns it off.
- The bone-bent kneel is gone: crouching exists only with Apocaplayer's crouch clips.

Install: unzip, copy `NPCAI/NPCAI.dll` into `BepInEx/plugins/`.

mods.name: Part Adjuster Tools
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: The Part Adjustment tool can also select the suspension: widen or narrow both axles and raise or lower the suspension (numpad 4/6/2/8, 0 resets), saved per car.

latest.title: Part Adjuster Tools 1.4.0
latest.notes:
## Part Adjuster Tools 1.4.0

**No more physics changes.** The 1.3.0 parking hold left some cars unable to move; it is gone, together with the 1.2.0 driver/wheel-collider rule. The mod no longer touches a car's physics or wheels.

The one stability rule left is the **centre of mass** (`LiftCenterOfMass`, on/off, default on): a car with a suspension lift kit carries it 0.3 m lower, plus 1.5 x any extra lift of the body, so a tall car on big wheels does not flip in turns. Apocapatrol 2.5.0 applies the same rule to its raider cars.

SHA256 of the zip is in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

latest.title: WomenOfWasteland 1.0.0
latest.notes:
First standalone release. Female raiders in the wasteland: female models and textures, their own voice lines, female corpses, and the appearance saved with the game. Ships its Models and Sounds folders next to the DLL.

Part of the Apocaraider split: **Gunplay**, **GunplayHUD**, **NPCAI** and **WomenOfWasteland** replace the combined Apocaraider (now frozen).
